title: Storm the Holds
changes: Storm a clan camp: cut down its guards, step into the courtyard and press E at its middle to raise your banner. It takes 12 seconds, a defender nearby holds it up and a blow starts it over.
A sacked Hold loses its grip on the land, drops a war chest and has no guards until the next war tick. Your banner flies over it, and a land pushed low enough comes under siege by your clan.
Valor now comes from fighting: soldiers of clans at war with yours, their heroes, caravans, rams, tunnels, rituals, sieges and sacked Holds.
Standards are for oaths now: swear there, then go and fight. Standing in a ring no longer earns valor, and the boards no longer hand out hold writs.
